Booking.title: Customer Cab Booking
Booking.description: Represents a customer cab booking made on safarindiacabs.com managed in the Customer Operations Control Room.

customerName.description: Full name of the customer who booked the ride

customerPhone.description: Customer 10-digit Indian mobile number with optional +91 prefix

customerEmail.description: Customer email address for itinerary and GST tax invoice

customerGstin.description: Optional customer B2B GSTIN for input tax credit on invoice

perKmRate.description: Applied per-KM base rate in INR

baseFare.description: Computed distance base fare in INR

stateTax.description: Inter-state permit and toll tax estimate in INR

marketDiscount.description: Competitive market price discount applied in INR (e.g. 200)

gstAmount.description: 5% SAC 996412 GST tax amount in INR

totalFare.description: Final net payable fare inclusive of GST and discount in INR

paymentMode.description: Customer advance payment selection on safarindiacabs.com

advancePaid.description: Amount already collected online via Razorpay/UPI in INR

balanceAmount.description: Remaining balance payable to driver/operations upon trip completion in INR

status.description: Current lifecycle status of the booking

driverName.description: Assigned chauffeur name shown in Customer My Rides

driverPhone.description: Assigned chauffeur mobile number shown in Customer My Rides

vehicleNumber.description: Assigned registration plate number (e.g., DL 01 CAB 4821)

vehicleModel.description: Specific car model dispatched (e.g., Maruti Swift Dzire CNG)

invoiceNumber.description: Generated GST Invoice number once Completed

invoiceReady.description: Whether final GST Invoice download is unlocked in customer My Rides

createdBy.description: UID of the authenticated admin or customer who created the record

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when booking was created

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when booking was last updated

TariffPlan.title: Outstation Vehicle Tariff & Pricing Config
TariffPlan.description: Per-KM rates, allowances, state taxes, and market discount rules for each vehicle category on safarindiacabs.com.

vehicleCategory.description: Display name of the vehicle category

sampleModels.description: Representative vehicle models shown on safarindiacabs.com

baseRatePerKm.description: Outstation round-trip per-KM rate in INR

oneWayRatePerKm.description: Outstation one-way drop per-KM rate in INR

minKmPerDay.description: Minimum billable kilometers per calendar day

driverAllowancePerDay.description: Default daily driver bata / allowance (DA) in INR

nightChargeDefault.description: Default night driving charge (10 PM to 6 AM) in INR

stateTaxDefault.description: Default state border permit tax estimate in INR

gstPercentage.description: Applicable GST percentage (5% for cab services)

marketDiscountEnabled.description: Whether the competitive market price discount is active for this category

marketDiscountAmount.description: Flat competitive market discount in INR (default 200)

createdBy.description: UID of admin who initialized or owns this tariff record

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last tariff update

AdminUser.title: Customer Operations Admin Profile
AdminUser.description: Authorized admin operator record for admin.safarindiacabs.com

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the administrator

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when admin profile was created

/bookings/{bookingId}.description: Stores all customer cab bookings from safarindiacabs.com with driver assignment and GST invoice state.

/tariffs/{tariffId}.description: Stores outstation per-KM rates, state taxes, driver allowances, night charges, and ₹200 market discount logic per vehicle class.
